theme: Dark Mode (Tactical Oceanic / The Performance Pro Archetype)

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Avoid Inter for headings. Use fluid scaling text-4xl to text-6xl for main screens.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible for chat bubbles and dense data.

monospace_data.usage: For ranks, sea time numbers, dates, vessel IDs, and OTP verification inputs.

rules: NO Teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4)
Tinted Grey Rule: All greys (background/surface) must have a deep blue/indigo undertone, never pure #000000 or #808080.

surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Use border-collapse style layouts for dashboard elements with border-r border-b border-white/10.
Glassmorphism (Crystal): For sticky chat headers. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#12131A]/70 with 1px top border-white/10. NO purely transparent headers.
Blurred/Locked Content: For locked CV contacts, use backdrop-blur-md on text with an absolute center lock icon and a subtle gradient overlay to obscure text.
textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the main app background.
Grid pattern background for the Chat area to simulate radar/technical interface (opacity-10).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangular (rounded-none). Primary CTAs use Signal Orange (#FF5A00). Use transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. Hover state must lift (-translate-y-1) with a shadow.

chat_bubbles.user: bg-[#FF5A00] text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-4 text-base shadow-sm
chat_bubbles.bot: bg-[#12131A] text-[#F3F4F6] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-4 text-base shadow-sm
chat_bubbles.quick_replies: Bordered pills (border border-[#0066FF] text-[#0066FF]) inside bot area. Hover changes to bg-[#0066FF] text-white.

components.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized. Dark inputs (bg-black/20) with sharp 1px border. Focus states MUST have higher contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF5A00]).
components.cards: Flat, rectangular, dense styles. Avoid heavy shadows. Use 1px border-white/10 and flat backgrounds.
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a dense, high-end technical look.
components.toast: Use Sonner for OTP success, simulated payment success, and notifications.

grids_layouts.overall_structure: Hybrid Split Layout (Desktop). Left column (Chat UI, max-w-md, border-r border-white/10). Right column (Dashboard / Dynamic Data, flexible width). On mobile, Chat is the default view with a drawer/bottom-nav for Dashboard.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) for dashboard cards. Dense spacing (gap-4) for chat messages to maintain conversation context.
grids_layouts.bento_dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid for Dashboard. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Every pixel utilized for match history, stats, and saved profiles.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align form labels, inputs, and standard text. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.

motion.chat_entrance: Staggered fade-up for incoming chat bubbles.
motion.typing_indicator: Three dots bouncing or 'Receiving transmission...' text pulse.
motion.hover_states: Micro-animations on quick replies, dashboard rows, and buttons.
motion.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Do NOT use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text. Orange against white text is APCA compliant.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements (focus:ring-[#FF5A00]).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='chat-quick-reply-btn', data-testid='otp-submit-btn').

media.image_usage: Images are used primarily in the Dashboard (hero banner, company logos, vessel avatars). The chat UI is text-heavy but can display rich media cards (e.g., generated CV preview).

hero_vessel.description: Aerial view of a cargo ship
hero_vessel.placement: Dashboard welcome banner background, low opacity with gradient overlay

user_avatar.placement: Default profile image for Seafarers (until customized)

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install fonts: Cabinet Grotesk (headings), IBM Plex Sans (body), JetBrains Mono (data). Install @phosphor-icons/react. Install framer-motion, sonner, lucide-react.
instructions_to_main_agent.execution_flow: 1. Build Chat UI layout + Dashboard layout frame. 2. Implement conversational state machine (mocking the step-by-step flow). 3. Add Quick Replies and Form elements inside chat. 4. Build right-side Dashboard (blurred CVs, match history).
instructions_to_main_agent.critical: Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>, use Shadcn. Do not center align the app container. Implement mock payments as simple dialogs/toasts.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
